checks: A proper trace has 0<q_j(z)<1 for every cap and every positive fiber. Every one-facet motion is available in both signs by hypothesis. Positive coarea and properness justify the regular response calculation for each such motion.

The unnormalized barycentric normals sum to zero. With unit normals the positive relation has coefficients ||∇λ_j||, and the Euclidean coarea factors scale by the same quantity relative to barycentric threshold units. Both formulations therefore give the stated θ.
The own cap misses facet i for j=i. For j≠i, translating and shrinking facet i toward v_j by q_j gives exactly its cap trace and relative area (1−q_j)^(d−1). The whole-fiber fraction is (1−q_j)^d.

At each z the d+1 facet equations yield d equal summands in each equation, of value β/d. With d≥2 and fixed positive weights this pins q_i(z) independently of z. Equal total cap masses then pin one common q. The through-source threshold sum is one in relative coordinates, so q=1/(d+1), β=(d/(d+1))^d and θ is uniform.
The resulting coordinates b_i(z)+r_z/(d+1) are both centroid coordinates and the affine functions L_i(z). The inverse barycentric map therefore gives a single affine centroid map.
